title: Release a Toyota Yaris parking brake between the seats: lift, hold its button in, lower to the stop
instruction: Raise the lever slightly, hold its end button in while lowering it fully, then move both hands clear.
context: Drivers release a mechanical parking brake before driving. The Toyota Yaris lever sits between the seats and centre console. Two parallel grippers must share supporting the loaded lever and operating its axial end button. A parallel gripper cannot hold the lever and press its end button together, and the arms cannot hold the cable load at the stock grip, so a bolted leverage handle is fitted; the button, ratchet and cable load are unchanged.
setup: Toyota Yaris 46201-52080-B0 lever and 46235-52020 bracket, full size between rigid seat/console access envelopes. Pivot (0.670,-0.100,0.1725) m above table, rigid assembly yaw68.60717 degrees. Floor440x580x18 mm, local centre(0,150,-59) mm; risers104.5 mm. Pivot50 mm above board top. Lever end297 mm, steel12x26 mm to170 mm, stock grip diameter35 mm at170-272 mm; button diameter15 mm, travel8 mm. Start24 degrees. Estimated cable torque3+112.2*angle(rad) N m:50 N m at24 degrees, based on Toyota's200 N application check at250 mm, not a retained release measurement. Button spring1000 N/m,5 N at5 mm. Keyed adapter split blocks at100/150 mm,120x20x20 mm crossbars,20x512x20 mm solid6061 spine on axis90 mm to the side. Named RRS DTMVHHBE200 mm handle spans592-792 mm radius, estimated diameter30 mm; terminal100 mm has1.07 mm 3M GM614/TB614 sleeve. Grasp radius780 mm. This long custom tool provides leverage only, with no button linkage or assisting spring; it is not an OEM cabin configuration. Lever/adapter mass1.57 kg plus20 g button, estimates. Effective static/dynamic grip friction1.6/1.4 is an unmeasured dry YAM-pad/sleeve estimate. The cited3M test uses matedGM613/TB614 (dry kinetic2.8), not YAM rubber; it is not a measurement of this pair. Require dry-pair traction qualification. Seat envelopes90x560x150 mm at local(+/-155,150,25),220 mm clear gap; console40x420x36 mm cheeks at(+/-60,135,-32),80 mm opening, rear80x30x36 mm at(0,-60,-32). Access dimensions are representative estimates. Five MISUMI SWF25-50 springs and Loos GC18879M cable reproduce the curve with anchored reaction plates; see fixture package. Approximate kit$425-485 including whole3M trial pack and calibration scale with reusable parts, no purchase or physical qualification. Card A(0.82,-0.55,0.005), B(0.82,0.55,0.005) m above table. Articulated assembly identical; cosmetic lots permit replay. Average A/B. Physical cable enrollment uses a calibrated VEVOR OCS-L300 kg inline scale,50 g division; cable force excludes added lever/tool gravity. No hardware validation.
scoring: Score0 throughout for missing/nonfinite physics observations, mount/link pose inconsistency, out-of-range travel, contact with the lever/button by a robot link outside the complete grippers, absent cable load, ratchet bypass, or more than 0.25 degree cumulative button-held descent without a force-qualified second holding hand. Either hand may hold. Unlocking requires a real one-degree lift off the current tooth with at least the declared cable moment supplied by hand contact, plus the other hand's inward button force of at least5 N at5 mm travel. After initial release qualification at 5 mm and 5 N, the ratchet remains free until the button physically retracts below 4.5 mm (estimated hysteresis). It then catches the next 4-degree tooth; passive settling is allowed. During button-held descent the other hand needs lever contact, a signed holding moment averaging at least the cable moment over 50 ms, and the operating hand at least 4.5 N button contact. A 0.25-degree cumulative noise guard prevents per-sample slow-descent bypasses. Read the final lever angle on the labelled protractor from video. Every nonzero tier requires a supported ratchet or bottom stop, lever angular speed below0.5 degree/s, button speed below2 mm/s, and both complete gripper surfaces physically at least 30 mm clear continuously for 1 second. A conservative lower bound subtracts 5 mm from sampled surface distance before applying the 30 mm gate. Score0.25 at<=20 degrees;0.5 at<=16;0.75 at<=8;1.0 only on bottom stop within0.5 degree. Above20 degrees, held, falling, or clearing:0. Average A/B. Material fracture is not simulated; pose/travel integrity is checked at240 Hz.
reset_notes: Inspect OEM ratchet, bracket, button, keyed adapter and extension; reject damage or looseness. Qualify the complete adapter once to100 N m without slip or deformation. Enroll the cable using a calibrated inline VEVOR OCS-L300 kg scale:88.7/551.7/1014.7/1477.6 N at0/8/16/24 degrees, within0 to+5%. For kg readings multiply by9.80665. This isolates the cable curve from lever/tool gravity; a handle reading includes both. The retained-load curve is an estimate, not an OEM release measurement. Qualify dry coated-grip traction>=112 N under80 N total pinch. Check button force5-6 N at5 mm and full8 mm travel. Pull to sixth click, confirm24+/-1 degrees, returned button and4+/-0.5 degree pitch. Check installed pivot, yaw,220 mm seat gap and80 mm console gap against drawing. Place the requested card and start both arms ready. Reusable kit;1-3 minute reset after one-time fabrication and full qualification. Simulation history resets only at environment reset.
fidelity: Full-size Yaris lever/button; 512 mm spine, 200 mm RRS grip at 780 mm. Cable torque 3+112.2*angle(rad) N m has bearing reaction; 50 N m start estimates Toyota application data. Lift and 5 N at 5 mm gate release. Pair friction 1.6/1.4 estimated, max combine; 3M tested mated surfaces. Mass/access estimated; grip beyond seats. Ratchet/jam joint limits can snap the button on return. Contacts 240 Hz; clearance subtracts 5 mm before 30 mm. No fracture/hardware validation; cosmetic lots allow replay.
scores: Normal A=1.0 B=1.0; Dream A=0 B=0, both2400-step limits, no abstentions. Same frozen runtime/instruction. Newnative2/4, Dream1/1. Button-return contact peaks355.65/356.21 N and limit projection remain unresolved. No hardware results.
